initial.reason: Monomer1 is 1,3-bis(glycidyloxy)benzene (aromatic diepoxide). It contains the required C1OC1 epoxide substring (and a second epoxide as C2OC2) to enable epoxy crosslinking and provides a rigid, aromatic backbone to raise Tg toward the 175°C target and increase modulus. Monomer2 is diethylenetriamine (NCCNCCN): it contains the required NC motif twice and provides multiple nucleophilic amine sites for epoxy ring-opening (epoxy–amine curing), producing a high crosslink density to push Er toward the target (~100) while also supporting a high Tg when cured with the aromatic diepoxide.
